summary: Willdan Group filed an 8-K reporting completion on October 30, 2026 of its previously announced acquisition of 100% of Mantis Intermediate Holdings, LLC via subsidiary Willdan Energy Solutions, under a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement dated September 22, 2026 with Seller Mantis NewCo. Consideration was approximately $285.0 million cash, subject to customary post-closing adjustments, funded by $35.0 million under the existing Revolving Credit Facility and $250.0 million under an amended Credit Agreement. The filing also discloses a Second Amendment to the credit facility with BMO Harris as administrative agent. Watch leverage and integration execution.
